description: This file defines a React class component ErrorBoundary which handles errors in component rendering. It manages error state, catches errors, logs them, and displays an error message when an error occurs.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component that provides error boundary functionality, catching rendering errors in its child components and displaying a fallback UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorBoundary component and sets the initial state.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method to update state when an error is thrown in a child component.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Logs errors to the console when an error is caught.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders fallback UI if an error has occurred; otherwise, renders children components.
